open_findings.finding: NEW TRAP, nearly caused a false negative: RunPod templates carry a volumeMountPath field reading /workspace even on templates used by SERVERLESS endpoints. It is pod-only and serverless ignores it - serverless templates expose no mount-path option because the path is fixed.

I hit this myself and briefly concluded the flag did not exist.
